Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a tobacco products tax credit for retailers for products transferred and used outside of the state.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tobacco products taxes; and adding a new sectionto chapter 82.26 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.26 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A credit is allowed to a retailer against the taxes imposed underthis chapter equal to the amount of taxes paid by the retailer underthis chapter on tobacco products that are transferred by the retailerto a consumer outside this state for use outside this state. Creditsshall first be applied to tax liability of the retailer under thischapter during the reporting period. Credits in excess of the taxliability under this chapter in a reporting period may be carriedforward to future reporting periods for a maximum of one year.
